metadata.dedupe: reflection family of (board, actor); transpositions share a board

generator.rule: per game a seeded style; each move uniform random with the style probability, else reference Negamax at a seeded style depth with seeded ties; self-symmetric boards excluded

metadata.method_b_rule: attempted for every base with >= 24 pieces under a 2000000-state budget; mirrors re-solved by method A
metadata.selection: no immediate win for the mover; wins need a non-winning action; draws need a losing action; losses must not be provable by a one-reply scan
metadata.split_rule: sealed quotas filled first from the shuffled pool, then development; disjoint families
